# HeroUI React LLMs.txt Quick Reference Index

> Documentation for HeroUI v3 React component library.

HeroUI v3 React is built on Tailwind CSS v4 and React Aria Components.

## Key Features
- Beautiful by default
- Accessible
- Flexible
- Developer-friendly with typed APIs
